intro: Sven's Camp is an Alliance quest in Duskwood that uncovers a crucial clue regarding the tragedy at the Yorgen homestead. By unearthing a buried, untitled journal from a mound of loose dirt on the abandoned farm, adventurers piece together who witnessed the slaughter of Sven Yorgen's family.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.
The book has no title, but...it has information Sven would like to know.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You found what?? Please, let me see it...

clips.title: Completion
paras: That shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death! There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!
